title: Apple Pie Liquor
description: This apple pie liquor will help you keep warm during the holiday season made with grain alcohol mixed with a spiced apple juice-based syrup.
ingredients: 6 (6 ounce) cans frozen apple juice concentrate, thawed
1 (750 milliliter) bottle 190 proof grain alcohol (such as Everclear®)

steps.text: Mix water, apple cider, apple juice concentrate, white sugar, brown sugar, and cinnamon sticks together in a large saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until mixture is reduced, about 45 minutes. Remove from heat and cool for 15 minutes.
Stir grain alcohol into mixture until evenly combined. Cool apple pie liquor completely. Pour apple pie liquor and 1 cinnamon stick into a jar or container.
